milestones.title: Advance preparations to rebuild Jambatan Temangau
milestones.description: Zaliha reported that final preparations were underway for the RM3 million, 50-metre replacement bridge serving Kemelah and Medoi, following the 2023 flood damage.
milestones.progress_note: A May pre-construction snapshot. PETRA, JPS and implementing agencies share responsibility. A construction start, finished bridge, exact deadline and numerical completion metric were not verified.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
